5. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 6. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 21 months Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 20 months usable shelf life should be available / balance. 7. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. (ii) Technical Compliance Declaration (with deviations if any clearly stated) (iii) Bid security declaration (iv) Bidder financial standing (v) Non disclosure certificate

(vi) Valid OEM authorisation certificate (vii) Acceptance of Bid T&C (viii) MSME certificate (pertaining to tender category only) (ix) MII declaration (duly mentioning percentage of local content of the bidders). If any firm fails to upload required documents within the date of bid opening, it will be liable for disqualification. (c) Bidders are to submit duly filled and signed Technical Compliance Declaration, as per specification of th e offered product in comparison with Bid Specifications Document . Any deviation with the technical para meters including List of Deliverables, Materials used, Sub-assemblies, Test Procedures, Optical/Mechanical/ Electrical Characteristics and Warranty of 12 months from date of supply should be clearly indicated at the time of bidding. (d) Format of Bid Security Declaration in place of Bid Security is as follows:- "We, (Name of the Bidder/ Fir m), hereby accept that, if we withdraw or modify our bids during the period of validity, or if we are awarde d the contract and we fail to sign the contract, or to submit a performance security before the deadline def ined in the Tender/ Bid documents, we will be suspended for a period of six months and will not be eligible to submit Bids/ participate in any further Tenders issued by the Tender Inviting Authority during that perio d. (e) Format for Acceptance of Bid T&C is as follows : "We, (Name of the Bidder/ Firm), hereby accept that, w e have read and understood the complete bid document and hereby submit our acceptance to the Terms a nd Conditions, as well as ATC specified in the Bid document." (f) Details of the product offered viz Technical Parameters, List of Deliverables/Scope of Work, Make and M odel, Inspection Criteria, Scope of Supply, List of Onboard Spares, Bill of Material etc should be uploaded al ong with the bid. (g) Firms not furnishing Past Performance Certificate will be disqualified. (h) Delivery Period:- 365 days from the date of Purchase Order. PSPP (Part Supply Part Payment ) 02 Lots, 50% quantity within 120 days and the balance 50% within the overall delivery period of 365 days. Delivery period will be extended only in exceptional cases provided communication is received from the fir m at least 30 days prior the expiry of delivery period. (i) Inspection Terms: Inspection to be carried out by DQA(N) (j) Quote TOV should include Basic Rates, GST, Custom Duty (IF APPLICABLE), Inspection/Testing charges ( if applicable) and all other relevant costs. There is no provision on GeM to increase the value of commerci al bid once bids are opened. (k) Quality Assurance Document - Document No QAD-R03 issued by Directorates of Quality Assurance (Wa rship Project and Naval), New Delhi available at https://www.dgqadefence.gov.in will be the reference doc ument for QA.10 / 12. (l) L1 firm is to supply the items and ensure following documents are dispatched along with the item at the time of delivery: i) Inspection note copy ii)Tax Invoice iii) Guarantee Warranty certificate. (m) E- Invoice is to generated by the vendors using GSTN 29BLRA16713E1DF.
